meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Acne-prone skin ke liye **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** meri top recommendation hai—especially agar blackheads, whiteheads ya oily skin hai. Iski price aam taur par ₹250–₹550 ke aas-paas milti hai, seller ke hisaab se.[1][5][8]

**Alternatives:**
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — active pimples aur clogged pores ke liye; lagbhag ₹182–₹448.[5][10]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Serum** — oil control, redness aur acne marks ke liye; lagbhag ₹187–₹508.[1][5][9]
- **Azelaic acid 10% serum** — acne ke saath dark marks/pigmentation bhi ho to; Derma Decode option lagbhag ₹587.[1]

**Kaise use karein:**  
Raat mein cleanser ke baad salicylic-acid serum ki 2–3 drops **hafte mein 2–3 baar** lagayein, phir moisturiser. Ek hi active se shuru karein—salicylic acid, niacinamide aur retinol ko ek saath na lagayein, warna irritation ho sakti hai.[3] Din mein **SPF 30+ sunscreen** zaroor lagayein.

Agar acne painful/cystic hai, scars ban rahe hain, ya 8–12 hafton mein improvement nahi hoti, dermatologist ko dikhayein.[3]
